query: Nigel Farage Clacton 2024 general election vote share percentage and votes, turnout, and Reform UK national polling 2026
answer:
Research complete. Here is a summary of my findings:

## Clacton 2024 General Election (4 July 2024)
- **Nigel Farage (Reform UK):** 21,225 votes, **46.2%** share
- **Majority:** 8,405 votes (18.3 points) — Reform gain from Conservative
- **Turnout:** 58.7% (45,958 total votes cast)
- Runners-up: Con 12,820 (27.9%), Lab 7,448 (16.2%), LD 2,016 (4.4%), Green 1,935 (4.2%)

## Key Development
Farage **resigned the seat on 7–8 July 2026** to trigger a by-election amid scrutiny over undeclared donations. The **Clacton by-election is set for 13 August 2026**, with Labour, Conservatives, Lib Dems, Greens and Restore Britain all declining to stand — leaving novelty candidate "Count Binface" as his main challenger.

## Reform UK National Polling (2026)
Reform has led Westminster voting intention for over a year:
- **YouGov 12–13 July 2026:** Reform 24%, Con 19%, Lab 19%, Green 15%, LD 13%
- **YouGov 5–6 July 2026:** Reform 25%, Con 21%, Lab 20%
- **BritPolls poll-of-polls (June 2026):** Reform 27%, Labour 19.2%, Conservatives 18.6%

Reform sits consistently in the mid-20s%, roughly double its ~14% national share at GE2024, in a fragmented multi-party field where Labour has fallen ~13–15 points since taking office.

key_facts: Nigel Farage won Clacton in 2024 with 21,225 votes and a 46.2% vote share.
His majority was 8,405 votes (18.3 percentage points) over the Conservatives (Reform gain from Conservative).
Turnout in Clacton 2024 was 58.7%, with 45,958 total votes cast across 9 candidates.
Runners-up: Conservative 12,820 (27.9%), Labour 7,448 (16.2%), Lib Dem 2,016 (4.4%), Green 1,935 (4.2%).
Farage resigned the Clacton seat on 7-8 July 2026 to trigger a by-election amid personal-finance/undeclared-donation allegations.
The 2026 Clacton by-election is scheduled for 13 August 2026; major parties are not standing candidates.
Reform UK has led UK national Westminster polling for over a year.
Latest YouGov (12-13 July 2026): Reform 24%, Con 19%, Lab 19%, Green 15%, Lib Dem 13%.
YouGov 5-6 July 2026: Reform 25%, Con 21%, Lab 20%, Green 13%, Lib Dem 12%.
Reform won roughly 14% nationally at the July 2024 general election; Labour has since fallen ~13-15 points from its 33% GE24 share.
